data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for the Razorpay payment gateway SDK.
data.what_it_does: Wraps native Android and iOS Razorpay SDKs to handle checkout, payment success, payment errors, and external wallets in Flutter applications.
use_when: You need to integrate Razorpay payments into your Flutter app.
You want to process standard checkout and order flows using native platform SDKs.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
You need a backend-only payment processing client.
strengths: Supports both Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods on iOS.
Provides clear error handling and event-based callbacks.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration (minSdkVersioning for Android, deployment target and bitcode for iOS).
Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum Android SDK to 19 or higher, adding Proguard rules if needed, and setting iOS minimum deployment target to 10.0.
